name: aspen
description: A sophisticated Shopify Hydrogen theme designed for home furniture and interior design stores. Built with React Router,    Weaverse, and modern web technologies for lightning-fast performance.

paragraphs: Aspen is a sophisticated Shopify theme crafted specifically for home furniture and interior design stores. Powered by Hydrogen, React Router, and Weaverse, this theme delivers lightning-fast storefronts with exceptional performance and elegant design aesthetics perfect for showcasing furniture collections, home decor, and interior design services.
features: weaverse is a WeaverseClient instance that has been injected into the app context by Weaverse. It provides a set of methods to interact with the Weaverse API.
Weaverse pages is rendered using component.
Weaverse global theme settings is loaded in the root's loader with context.weaverse.loadThemeSettings function.
And then you can use it in your components with useThemeSettings hook.
The App component is wrapped with withWeaverse HoC in order to SSR the theme settings.
